title: shoalkit: linear and Stokes wave transformation with Lagrangian drift
description: A small, citable, dependency-free Python package for linear (Airy) and Stokes water-wave theory. It solves the dispersion relation and reproduces the University of Delaware / CACR wave-calculator output set (wavelength, wavenumber, celerity, group velocity, direction, shoaling and refraction coefficients, bottom orbital velocity), provides closed-form Airy and second-order Stokes surface elevation, and exposes the Ursell number with a transparent wave-theory applicability gate. It additionally answers the Lagrangian question that Eulerian wave calculators do not: the closed-form Stokes drift profile, the depth-integrated Stokes transport, a single mean drift velocity directly comparable to the net velocity a GNSS-tracked drifter reports, and an RK4 particle integrator whose net parcel velocity converges to the closed form as wave steepness vanishes. A raschii bridge supplies higher-order Stokes and Fenton stream-function profiles.
